title: Hunting the Moon
summary: On Planet Yun Xia Wang Lin finds the Moonwatcher partly awake, and plants Celestial Ascension Fruits at the roots of most of its tentacles to numb it. He learns that Tan Lang, the elders' pursuer from the Alliance, broke one of its bones and disturbed its deadly Moonblight, and found him trapped in its gut, the only one to follow him. Wang Lin uses the tearing Netherworld Force he learned in the abyss to rip out the Moonwatcher's bone, but the beast wakes and speaks Ancient God words that shatter the sky. He sacrifices his Restriction Flag and the Seven-Star Sword Formation to slow it, while Tan Lang breaks out and attacks him with the Landscape Screen and the Immortal Emperor Crown. Wang Lin throws Tan Lang half the bone as bait and answers the Moonwatcher's finger with his life imprint, his second Immortal Guard and Ling Tianhou's sword qi. To get away he abandons his body and flees in soul form, until a month later the Moonwatcher stops at the edge of Allheaven's Southern Domain, and Wang Lin looks for a place to forge a new body and refine the bone.
